title: Safari ya Nafsi Iliyoasiliwa
intro: Katika wakati ambapo kanuni za kijamii zilitawala, mtu wa kipekee alipata mabadiliko makubwa ndani ya nyumba iliyobarikiwa. Hadithi yao, iliyoonyeshwa na kifungo cha upendo na amri ya Mungu, inaonyesha uvunjaji wa mila za zamani na uanzishwaji wa kanuni mpya na za haki. Simulizi hii inaangazia umuhimu wa ukweli kuliko desturi na hekima iliyo nyuma ya amri za Mwenyezi Mungu.
clues: Wakati mmoja nilikuwa mateka, lakini kupitia mpango wa Mungu, nilipata makazi mapya na familia.
Nilipendwa sana kiasi kwamba nilipopewa chaguo kati ya familia yangu ya kibiolojia na mlezi wangu wa kulelewa, nilichagua kubaki na mlezi huyo wa mwisho.
Jina langu liliwahi kuhusishwa na mlezi wangu wa kulelewa, desturi ambayo ilikuwa ya kawaida katika jamii yangu.
Mimi ndiye sahaba pekee wa Mtume wa mwisho ambaye jina lake limetajwa waziwazi na Mwenyezi Mungu katika Quran.
Nilioa mwanamke mtukufu ambaye alikuwa binamu wa Mtume, lakini ndoa yetu haikudumu.
Baada ya talaka yangu, Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenyewe aliamuru kwamba mke wangu wa zamani angeolewa na Mtume, na hivyo kubatilisha desturi ya kale kuhusu kuasili.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
